reviews.text:
Very caring,always puts my wee guy at ease
I always get good advice from the vet 🙂
Very helpful and friendly service
My little dog Coco was very well looked after by staff at bishopbriggs vet the staff are so friendly and very helpful and I can't thank them enough

We registered our rescue dog here without knowing to much about the practise. And yes its been the best decision the staff clearly all love their jobs and nothing is ever to much for them.
Our dog runs in the door cause he knows its a safe space
Would highly recommend

I’ve been using this vet 9 years plus always felt reception staff very friendly helpful x Henry was always Victir Milo’s vet he’s excellent but in last two years I’ve saw Chiara She helped me so much when Victor was ill before he passed last August xMilo adores her she the best 🐾🐾 plus I’ve saw few other vets and all brilliant would highly recommend 🐾
great vets good location ,my family and our pets have been with the practice for over 20 years never ever had an issue , carry on with the great work .
All staff are so friendly and very helpful and I know my pets are in excellent hands with the professionals.  Have been going to this practice for many years and cannot recommend this place enough.
I have been using this vet for 20yrs+ and have always found all staff to be very caring to my pets also showing empathy when it comes to the loss of a pet.
Very friendly staff good professional service at very short notice. Excellent treatment of my young dog.
Great vet, very quick to be seen, staff really helpfull and welcoming would recommend
Took my mums wee dog there . The care and experience was absolutely top class . No fuss and expert knowledge . Can't recommend enough . Thanks for looking after my wee dog 🙏 …
Jess was attended to in a very professional manner and her nails were clipped without any hassle, thank you very much
HI Darryl, thank you for leaving us a 5-star review. Kind regards ☺️

Recently registered our new pup, Orla, very happy with the service received from the reception staff to all the vets involved so far. Providing relevant information, listening, answering any questions we had and organising next appointment requirements. Friendly helpful staff, definitely recommend.
Have attended BB vets for years with all my dogs and always visit Henry . Trust him implicitly with all my dogs health , extremely thorough vet . Recently visited Greg another fantastic vet !
A very friendly and welcoming veterinary centre. Even my dog loves it there !
Hi Andy, thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review. Kind regards ☺️
Hi Colin, thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review. Kind regards ☺️
Friendly staff, advice given regarding changing treatment plan. Visit was for annual booster.
All staff are very friendly as soon as you walk in the door.  They are caring and do whatever they can for your animal.
They were so kind and helpful
Top class vet.. staff love our dogs.🐕 …
Very professional staff from first contact until leaving with my dog that day. Also I felt they went out their way in explaining everything I was to do. Made a stressful day a lot easier.
Great service,  professional and reasonable prices,  excellent and would recommend
VERY FRIENDLY AND ON THE BALL
Have used this practice for over 38 years and could not fault it in any way. All the staff over the years have been great with my dogs and I would not hesitate to recommend them.

It is always a pleasant experience visiting Bishopbriggs Veterinary Centre.  The reception staff are really friendly and make a big deal of my dog and she loves the attention, making her visit to the Vet less anxious. Last night I saw Vet Natasha - she was lovely and very helpful, providing lots of guidance and took good care of Poppy.
Apollo enjoyed meeting all the staff for his first check-up; everyone was incredibly friendly.
Hi Colin, thank you for taking the time to leave us this 5-star review. Kind regards ☺️

My wee lola goes here .  Staff are always very helpful and good at putting your mind at ease, if you are worried about anything with your pet, the staff are always clear  concise and informative at all times.  Lola isn't keen on men so always good when we get a female vet.
